message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of the most highly regarded sushi spots in Los Angeles (in no particular order). All of them consistently receive rave reviews from locals and food critics alike:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic Edomae-style nigiri, fresh fish, and a lively atmosphere. Known for its “sashimi bar” where you can watch chefs at work. |
| **Sugarfish** | West Hollywood & Downtown | A modern take on traditional sushi with a focus on high‑quality fish and a relaxed, open‑kitchen vibe. Their “sushi bar” menu offers a great balance of value and quality. |
| **Sushi Park** | Koreatown | A hidden gem that serves up authentic Japanese dishes, including a wide variety of sashimi and nigiri. The chef’s counter is a favorite for watching the preparation process. |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | A small, intimate spot that specializes in hand‑rolled rolls made with premium ingredients. Great for those who love creative roll combinations. |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Chef Nobu Matsuhisa’s flagship restaurant offers a mix of classic sushi and his signature fusion dishes. It’s a bit pricier but worth it for a special night out. |

If you’re looking for something more casual or budget‑friendly, consider checking out **Sushi Ota** (West Hollywood) or **Sushi Tetsu** (Beverly Hills), both of which offer excellent quality at a slightly lower price point.

Happy dining!
